# Compute like_count for each unique song in all playlists
song_ids = unique_song_ids  # from prior code
like_info = []
for sid in song_ids:
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    like_info.append({
        'song_id': sid,
        'title': s.get('title'),
        'like_count': s.get('like_count')
    })

# Print verification of top few by like_count
sorted_like = sorted(like_info, key=lambda x: (-x['like_count'], unique_song_ids.index(x['song_id'])))
print('total_unique_songs', len(song_ids))
print('top_10_by_like', sorted_like[:10])

max_like = max(x['like_count'] for x in like_info)
print('max_like_count', max_like)
# find all songs with max_like
cands = [x for x in like_info if x['like_count'] == max_like]
print('candidate_song_ids_max', [c['song_id'] for c in cands])
# tie-break by first appearance in unique_song_ids order
first_idx = min(unique_song_ids.index(c['song_id']) for c in cands)
best = [c for c in cands if unique_song_ids.index(c['song_id'])==first_idx][0]
print('best', best)
